settings.label: Console button in combat log
settings.note: Show Console in the full combat log to read, copy or export console output and errors from this session. No saved game or profile is attached.

settings.label: Player name color
settings.note: Choose the color used for player names in the combat log. Colors with low contrast use the readable default.

settings.label: Enemy name color
settings.note: Choose the color used for enemy names in the combat log. Colors with low contrast use the readable default.

settings.label: Auto combat
settings.note: Answers your reaction prompts for you, countering the attack you can read. It never plays cards or ends your turn.

settings.label: Combat speed ×
settings.note: Scales action waits and sprite playback together. Does not change combat results.

settings.label: Auto combat speed ×
settings.note: Speed while auto combat is on, in place of Combat speed. Default ×1.5. Does not change combat results.

settings.label: Pause between steps (ms)
settings.note: The pause between each step of an action: the action, its animation, hit or miss, the target reaction, the final result, then the reset. 0 to 2000 ms (0 turns pauses off), default 500 ms, before the speed multiplier. Does not change combat results.

settings.label: Animation step duration (ms)
settings.note: Sprite animation duration at normal speed. Independent of the pause between combat steps.

settings.label: Combat pacing preset
settings.note: Mobile fast sets the pause to 250 ms and animation duration to 195 ms. Edit either value to customize.

settings.label: Combat pacing
settings.note: Auto uses Fast with Lite rendering and Normal with Full. Choose a pace to override it.

settings.label: Tap a card to play it
settings.note: Off (the default): a tap selects the card, and the next tap on it, or picking a target, plays it. This holds in solo and in co-op. On: one tap plays a card when there is only one possible target: a self card, an all-enemy card, or one living enemy. With several enemies a tap still selects. Holding a card selects it without playing, which shows its details and Upcast.
